description: Housing is more than just shelter. It’s the foundation of our communities, the backbone of local economies, and the key to stability for families and small businesses alike. Yet, too many residents in New York State Assembly District 38 face skyrocketing rents, limited options, and policies that don’t serve their needs. It’s time to rethink housing policies with a sharp focus on affordable housing strategies that create real, lasting local impact.I’m here to break down what needs to change, why
